items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'That's all right, don't worry about it. I'll teach you.' So he taught me the fingering.

ctx.x: Mouthpiece maker. So he wanted to know if I -- what instrument I wanted to play. So I couldn't think of nothing else but the bass drums. And he said, 'oh, no.' Said, 'You don't want -- how you going to play bass drum? You can only play bass drum in one band, that's like a military band.'

So I said, 'Well, you got it.' So he went upstairs and come downstairs with an old, beat-up tuba, and handed it to me. So I said, 'What can I do with this, Charlie?' I said, 'this has only got three valves. I play violin with seven positions.' He said, 'That's all right, don't worry about it. I'll teach you.' So he taught me the fingering.
Well, was Charlie a student then, or --
